paper.title_en: Critical Kasner scaling from Cauchy-horizon collapse near holographic phase transitions
paper.abstract_en: We study continuous scalar-hair bifurcations from stationary black holes with a nonextremal Cauchy horizon. Although the exterior deformation vanishes at criticality, the critical zero mode generically develops a logarithmic branch at the reference Cauchy horizon, producing a nonuniform critical limit. We show that the coefficient of this logarithm in the scalar perturbation, together with local Cauchy-horizon data, determines the exponential collapse rate of the Einstein-Rosen bridge. If the post-collapse geometry evolves into a Kasner regime, the boundary order-parameter scaling $O\propto|λ-λ_c|^β$ further implies $ 1-p_t\propto|λ-λ_c|^{2β}. $ Crucially, zero-mode matching fixes both the critical exponents and the associated amplitudes, without any fit to the nonlinear interior. We illustrate this mechanism in the transition from rotating BTZ to hairy rotating black holes. For scalarized RN-AdS$_4$ black branes, we quantitatively verify the predicted Kasner scaling using fully nonlinear numerical solutions. At low temperature, two charged models with identical linear critical data instead approach different infrared endpoints, yielding respectively power-law and inverse-logarithmic Kasner scaling. Thus interiors near a finite-temperature bifurcation are controlled by zero-mode transmission, whereas low temperature scaling is governed by the nonlinear infrared completion.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究带非极端Cauchy视界的黑洞在标量毛发分岔中的临界行为，将视界内部的Kasner坍缩与边界序参量标度联系起来，并给出无需拟合非线性内部区的匹配机制，兼具理论深度与非线性数值验证，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞物理交叉方向的高相关研究。
decision.title_zh: 靠近全息相变的Cauchy视界坍缩产生的临界Kasner标度
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有非极端Cauchy视界的稳态黑洞的连续标量毛发分岔。尽管在临界点外部形变消失，但临界零模通常在参考Cauchy视界处发展出对数分支，从而产生非均匀临界极限。我们表明，标量微扰中该对数的系数，连同局部Cauchy视界数据，决定了Einstein-Rosen桥的指数坍缩率。如果坍缩后的几何演化进入Kasner区域，则边界序参量标度 $O\propto|λ-λ_c|^β$ 进一步意味着 $1-p_t\propto|λ-λ_c|^{2β}$。关键的是，零模匹配同时固定了临界指数和相应的振幅，而无需对非线性内部区进行任何拟合。我们在从旋转BTZ到带毛发旋转黑洞的转变中说明了这一机制。对于标量化RN-AdS$_4$黑膜，我们使用完全非线性数值解定量验证了预测的Kasner标度。在低温下，两个具有相同线性临界数据的带电模型反而趋近不同的红外端点，分别产生幂律和逆对数Kasner标度。因此，有限温度分岔附近的内部区由零模透射控制，而低温标度则由非线性红外完成所支配。
